Class AppleScrollBar

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.AppleScrollBar
public final class AppleScrollBar extends Object
The AppleScrollBar paints overlay scroll bars. A bar floats on the edge of a JScrollPane instead of reserving a gutter. install(JScrollPane) arms the vertical bar and the horizontal bar of one pane. armStrip(JComponent, JScrollBar) arms one bar whose parent sets the bounds. The wide bar is BAR_PX pixels. The thin bar is THIN_PX pixels. The handle length is thumbSpan(int). The fade lasts ANIM_SEC seconds. The painted fade uses a cubic-out curve. The track color is PLATE. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#AppleScrollBar

  • Field Details

    • BAR_PX

      public static final int BAR_PX
      The BAR_PX constant is the wide bar thickness, in pixels. The value is fifteen. A pointer on the bar fades the thickness toward this width. The hit strip for a parent-laid bar uses this same thickness.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • THIN_PX

      public static final float THIN_PX
      The THIN_PX constant is the thin bar thickness, in pixels. The value is two. A pointer on the pane, and off the bar, fades the thickness toward this width.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • HANDLE_MIN

      public static final int HANDLE_MIN
      The HANDLE_MIN constant is twelve pixels. thumbSpan(int) chooses the painted handle length.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • THUMB_SHARE

      public static final float THUMB_SHARE
      The THUMB_SHARE constant is the handle's share of the track. The value is forty percent. The handle length does not follow the scroll range. AppleScrollBar.AppleBarUi.seatThumb(boolean) still maps the scroll value along the remaining travel.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • RADIUS_PX

      public static final float RADIUS_PX
      The RADIUS_PX constant is the corner radius, in pixels. The value is six. fill(Graphics2D, float, float, float, float, int, float) uses twice this value as the arc, then clamps the arc to the painted width and height.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • ANIM_SEC

      public static final float ANIM_SEC
      The ANIM_SEC constant is the fade time, in seconds. The value is two tenths of a second. step(float, boolean, float) moves the linear fade by the elapsed time divided by this value.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • PLATE

      public static final int PLATE
      The PLATE constant is the track color. The value is 0x0d0d0d. The painted track uses this color. A parent-laid bar also uses it as the bar background.

  • Constructor Details

    • AppleScrollBar

      private AppleScrollBar()
      The constructor stops callers from creating an instance. The body does nothing. Callers use install(JScrollPane) or armStrip(JComponent, JScrollBar).

  • Method Details

    • thumbSpan

      public static int thumbSpan(int track)
      The thumbSpan method returns the handle length for one track. A track below one pixel returns zero. Any other track multiplies its length by THUMB_SHARE and rounds to the nearest pixel. A rounded length below one pixel becomes one pixel. A rounded length above the track becomes the track length.
      Parameters:
      track - The track length on this axis, in pixels.
      Returns:
      The handle length, in pixels.

    • install

      public static void install(JScrollPane pane)
      The install method arms both bars of one scroll pane. A null pane returns immediately. A pane whose client property casserole.apple.scroll is already true returns immediately. Any other pane stores true in that property. The pane UI becomes an AppleScrollBar.ApplePaneUi.
      Parameters:
      pane - The scroll pane to arm, or null.

    • armStrip

      static void armStrip(JComponent host, JScrollBar bar)
      The armStrip method arms one bar whose parent sets the bounds. A null component returns immediately. A null bar returns immediately. A bar whose client property casserole.apple.strip is already true returns immediately. Any other bar stores true in that property. The bar UI becomes an AppleScrollBar.AppleBarUi. The bar is opaque. The background is PLATE. The border is removed. The bar does not take focus. AppleScrollBar.AppleMotion.watchStrip(JComponent, JScrollBar) starts the fade for that component and bar.
      Parameters:
      host - The component the pointer is tested against.
      bar - The bar to arm.

    • ensureEar

      private static void ensureEar()
      The ensureEar method installs one shared pointer listener. A listener that is already installed returns immediately. The new listener receives mouse events and mouse-motion events.

    • onMouse

      private static void onMouse(MouseEvent e)
      The onMouse method updates every armed component. A source that is not a component returns immediately. A cleared weak reference is removed from the list. A live component tells its fade whether the pointer is over it. A component with no fade is skipped. An empty list after that pass removes the shared listener. The listener field is then cleared.
      Parameters:
      e - The mouse event.

    • pointerOver

      private static boolean pointerOver(JComponent host, Component source, Point point)
      The pointerOver method tests one event point against a component. A null component, source, or point returns false. A component that is not showing returns false. A source that is not showing returns false. The point is converted into the component. The method returns whether the component contains that point.
      Parameters:
      host - The component to test.
      source - The component that produced the point.
      point - The point in the source.
      Returns:
      True when the point lies inside the component.

    • underPointer

      private static boolean underPointer(JComponent host)
      The underPointer method tests the current screen pointer. A null component returns false. A component that is not showing returns false. A missing pointer location returns false. The screen point is converted into the component. The method returns whether the component contains that point.
      Parameters:
      host - The component to test.
      Returns:
      True when the screen pointer lies inside the component.

    • motionOf

      private static AppleScrollBar.AppleMotion motionOf(Component component)
      The motionOf method finds the fade for a component. The search starts at the component and climbs through parents. The first Swing component whose casserole.apple.motion property is an AppleMotion is returned. A search that finds none returns null.
      Parameters:
      component - The starting component. A null value returns null.
      Returns:
      The fade, or null.

    • barUi

      private static AppleScrollBar.AppleBarUi barUi(JScrollBar bar)
      The barUi method reads the overlay painter from a bar. A null bar returns null. A bar whose UI is not an AppleScrollBar.AppleBarUi returns null.
      Parameters:
      bar - The bar to read.
      Returns:
      The painter, or null.

    • step

      private static float step(float linear, boolean target, float dt)
      The step method moves a linear fade toward zero or one. The step size is the elapsed time divided by ANIM_SEC. A fade time that is not positive uses a step of zero. A negative step becomes zero. A true target adds the step and stops at one. A false target subtracts the step and stops at zero.
      Parameters:
      linear - The current amount, from zero to one.
      target - True to move toward one. False to move toward zero.
      dt - The elapsed time, in seconds.
      Returns:
      The next linear amount.

    • moving

      private static boolean moving(float linear, boolean target)
      The moving method reports whether a linear fade has reached its end. The end is one when the target is true. The end is zero when the target is false. The method returns true when the linear value is not that end.
      Parameters:
      linear - The current amount.
      target - True when the fade is heading toward one.
      Returns:
      True while the amount is still changing.

    • eased

      private static float eased(float linear, boolean target)
      The eased method applies the cubic-out curve. A fade toward one returns cubicOut(float) of the linear amount. A fade toward zero returns one minus cubicOut(float) of one minus the linear amount.
      Parameters:
      linear - The current amount, from zero to one.
      target - True when the fade is heading toward one.
      Returns:
      The eased amount.

    • cubicOut

      private static float cubicOut(float t)
      The cubicOut method computes one cubic-out value. The result is the cube of t minus one, plus one.
      Parameters:
      t - The linear amount.
      Returns:
      The eased amount.

    • grayRgb

      private static int grayRgb(int gray)
      The grayRgb method repeats one gray level in red, green, and blue. The level is shifted into each byte. The method does not clamp the level.
      Parameters:
      gray - The gray level.
      Returns:
      The packed color.

    • fill

      private static void fill(Graphics2D g2, float x, float y, float w, float h, int rgb, float opacity)
      The fill method paints one rounded rectangle. A width at or below zero returns immediately. A height at or below zero returns immediately. An opacity at or below zero returns immediately. An opacity above one becomes one. The alpha is the opacity times 255, plus one half, then cast to an integer. An alpha below one returns immediately. An alpha above 255 becomes 255. Red, green, and blue are taken from the packed color. The arc starts at twice RADIUS_PX. An arc wider than the rectangle becomes the rectangle width. An arc taller than the rectangle becomes the rectangle height. The rectangle is filled with that color and alpha.
      Parameters:
      g2 - The graphics copy.
      x - The left edge.
      y - The top edge.
      w - The width.
      h - The height.
      rgb - The packed red, green, and blue.
      opacity - The opacity from zero to one.
